naya.summary: The human-facing product promise is push-button simple while the machinery underneath is highly intelligent: name + topic → generated assessment → 15 questions → deterministic score → personalized result → Naya Power learning loop.
lessons: AI creativity belongs upstream in assessment generation; deterministic MAXIS scoring belongs downstream.
The five-dimension model can remain while dimensions become subject-specific.

human.summary: A person should be able to choose almost any subject, ask Naya to teach it, use MAXIS to measure understanding, and see progress over time. The user should never need to understand the machinery underneath.
lessons: The assessment should be a useful challenge, not obscure trivia.
The ultimate product is a personal learning and growth relationship, not a test.

evidence: Legacy human vision was read in full and migrated.
